title: Dyadic-Order Quantum Fractional Transforms: Circuit Constructions and Applications to Hartley and Cosine Transform Families
summary: This paper presents a generalized circuit framework for constructing Shih-type fractionalizations of unitary operators of dyadic order, i.e., operators $U$ satisfying $U^{2^n}=I$. Building upon the architecture of the quantum fractional Fourier transform (QFrFT), we show that fractionalization can be implemented coherently as a weighted superposition of integer powers, $\sum_k c_k(α)U^k$, where the coefficients are generated through an ancilla-domain quantum Fourier transform and a diagonal phase modulation.
